title: Introduce smart auth fallback and generator helper to harmonize streaming ergonomics across SDKs
author: Liam O'Connor
description:
Context: multiple SDK integrations (Python/TypeScript/Go) have diverged in how they handle credential rotation, ephemeral fallbacks, and streaming consumer ergonomics. This PR centralizes the auth fallback logic into a small, portable contract and ships a lightweight 'generator sugar' helper that makes streaming responses ergonomic and idiomatic in each language without leaking transport details.

Motivation: reduce duplicate retry/fallback logic across SDKs, remove observed race conditions during token swap on intermittent auth errors, and provide a single-pattern streaming example for docs and quickstarts.

Summary of changes:
- Introduce AuthFallback (interface + default implementation) that composes primary credential provider with optional delegated fallback providers; provides explicit backoff and 'shouldRetryOnAuth' predicate.
- Add GeneratorSugar helper (polyglot concept implemented for Python runtime and TS shim; Go receives the lightweight iterator adapter) that converts raw streaming frames into typed async generators/iterators with built-in error mapping & retry hints.
- Harmonize token-refresh timing: prefer TTL-based jittered prefetch; explicit heartbeat hook added for long-lived streams.
- Bump SDK versions: py-sdk v1.31.0, ts-sdk v1.27.2, go-sdk v1.8.4.
- Add cross-SDK examples and update existing quickstarts.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement core auth fallback contract
- [x] Add generator sugar helpers in Python/TS and iterator adapter in Go
- [x] Unit tests for auth fallback decision paths
- [x] Integration test that simulates token rotation during active stream
- [x] Update docs and examples
- [x] Version bumps and changelogs

Commits summary: squash of 7 commits: "init: auth fallback contract and default impl", "feat(gen-sugar): python generator sugar + examples", "chore(ts): add shim + types for generator sugar", "fix(go): iterator adapter edge-case for EOF+auth", "test: simulate token rotation during streaming", "docs: update streaming quickstart and samples", "chore: bump sdk versions and changelogs".

Files changed (high level): sources/sdk/python/redwood/streaming.py, sources/sdk/python/redwood/auth.py, sources/sdk/python/tests/test_stream_rotation.py, sources/sdk/typescript/src/generatorSugar.ts, sources/sdk/typescript/test/stream-rotation.spec.ts, sources/sdk/go/stream/iterator_adapter.go, sources/sdk/go/auth/fallback.go, website/docs/streaming-auth.md, examples/streaming/auth-fallback-examples/*, packaging/py-sdk/setup.cfg, packaging/ts-sdk/package.json, packaging/go-sdk/go.mod.

Testing & CI: Initial CI run: build (pass), unit (pass), lint (fail on TS new helper style rules). Author fixed lint and force-pushed; second CI run: all checks passed except a flaky e2e in nightly-integration (timeout on simulated network jitter). Flaky test was quarantined and retried; final CI status is passing.

Observability: added lightweight telemetry tags on fallback usage and stream-retry reasons.

Review conversation (high level):
- Miguel Alvarez: "Question: how does the fallback affect cold-start latency when primary provider is slow?" Reply (author): "Fallback decision is lazy: we do not contact fallback providers until primary returns a 401/403 or the 'shouldRetryOnAuth' predicate triggers; added a unit to assert no extra calls on happy path."
- Priya Shah: "TS types feel a bit loose around the generator envelope." Reply (author): "Added stricter types and a test that asserts runtime mapping; kept a small any<> in a narrow shim to avoid duplicating transport types across packages."
- Asha Kumar (design): "Please add a short note in console explaining when fallback was used (for audit)." Reply (author): "Added an opt-in telemetry flag and console note in examples; not enabled by default to avoid noise."
- Daniel Kim (SRE): "Observed 2x increase in retry attempts during the first run against staging; is that expected?" Reply (author): "That was the flaky e2e's artifact; we lowered the default retry ceiling for streamed auth to prevent aggressive retry storms and documented the knob in runtime configs."

Merge outcome: Squash-merged into main after approvals. Merge commit: 4b8f6d9c1e5b2a7f3d9c1b0a6d8f9e2c3f4a5b6c. Rollout notes: shipped as coordinated SDK micro-release; serverside compatibility retained via runtime feature flag. Rollback plan: revert the squash merge and pin SDK clients to previous versions; server-side flag to disable fallback if unexpected behaviors surface.

- Add AuthFallback contract to unify multi-provider auth flows across SDKs.
- Introduce GeneratorSugar helpers to make streaming responses ergonomic in Python/TypeScript and add iterator adapter for Go.
- Hardened token-rotation handling during active streams.
- Bumped SDK versions: py v1.31.0, ts v1.27.2, go v1.8.4.
